Count Wrongula - Album 1: WHO

Counting Accounting

"Everything accounted, everything fine"

[Rubato Intro]

Three days there Three days back Formal coat Traveling pack

Tea for the road Bread for the night Everything counted Everything right

[Verse 1]

Shirts in the trunk Cuffs in the case Boots polished black Every button in place

Formal attire One spare for rain Food packed tightly Enough for the train

Carriage inspected Harnesses strong Three will accompany Nothing goes wrong

Fredo with provisions Tisha with bread Bella beside me Watching my head

[Pre-Chorus]

Count the coats Count the trays Count the meals for three long days Count the candles Count the wine

Everything accounted Everything fine

[Chorus]

Counting accounting One, two, three Everything exactly Where it ought to be

Counting accounting Before I depart Inventory the castle Inventory the heart

Doors will be guarded Gardens maintained Nothing gets eaten That ought to remain

Count every problem Count every doubt

If I count them all properly Perhaps they stay out

[Verse 2]

Wrongula gathers the household around Servants assemble without making a sound Gardens need tending The hedges need care Feed every chicken And leave them all there

No guests in the estate No strangers inside No wandering creatures Looking for somewhere to hide

Keep every window Exactly as set And if something breaks Try not to regret

He turns to the poultry Then turns to the staff

Do not eat the chickens

Bella coughs back a laugh

[Call and Response]

Feed them each morning

Obviously

Lock every gate

Naturally

Keep out intruders

Certainly

Do not eat poultry

That one was necessary

[Pre-Chorus]

Count the keys Count the doors Count the feathers on the floors Count the rules Count the doubt

Everything accounted Before heading out

[Chorus]

Counting accounting One, two, three Everything exactly Where it ought to be

Counting accounting Nothing left vague Not when thirteen elders Are waiting to interrogate

Why do you breakfast Why do you dine Why does daylight Suit you just fine

Why won’t you behave As a vampire should

Another three days For questions this good

[Verse 3]

He knows every question Before they are asked Centuries of judgment Behind every mask

Why are you different Why don’t you feed Why do you ignore What your bloodline should need

Why do you wander Beneath open skies Why do you eat eggs Why pastries and pies

Why keep a kitchen Why bother with bread Why live like this When tradition says dread

Bella checks weapons Without looking his way Already predicting Exactly what he’ll say

[Bridge]

They will call it improper They will call it strange They will call his habits Something he should change

They will speak of bloodlines They will speak of law They will speak as though tradition Never carried flaw

Fredo packs quietly Tisha ties twine Bella finally mutters

Your ego needs its own trunk this time

Wrongula looks wounded Deeply betrayed

Bella keeps working

A point has been made

[Final Chorus]

Counting accounting One, two, three Everything prepared For aristocracy

Counting accounting Coats, food and pride Three days to the council With Bella beside

Let them ask questions Let them complain Let them explain What a vampire should remain

Let them count customs Let them count blood

I’ll count every reason Their reasoning is mud

Three companions One carriage Thirteen waiting there

Everything accounted

Except why I should care

[Vamp Outro]

Trunks are loaded Gates swing wide Morning waits On the mountain side

Wrongula steps in Bella follows near

She studies the luggage

Then studies him

You forgot something

He checks every case

Nothing is missing

Bella nods toward his face

Humility

The carriage rolls on.
